CCK.Compat.WrongSystem: Combat Kit requires the Cyberpunk RED – CORE system.
CCK.Compat.UntestedVersion: Combat Kit was tested with Cyberpunk RED – CORE {tested}; this world uses {found}.
CCK.Attack.no-canvas: Combat Kit: no scene is open.
CCK.Attack.no-attacker: Combat Kit: select one token you own to attack with.
CCK.Attack.many-attackers: Combat Kit: select only one token to attack with.
CCK.Attack.no-target: Combat Kit: target one token to attack.
CCK.Attack.many-targets: Combat Kit: target only one token.
CCK.Attack.no-weapon: Combat Kit: this character has no equipped weapon.
CCK.Attack.not-equipped: Combat Kit: equip the weapon before attacking.
CCK.Attack.no-ammo: Combat Kit: the weapon is out of ammo. Reload first.
CCK.Attack.out-of-range: Combat Kit: the target is out of range for this weapon.
CCK.Attack.no-table: Combat Kit: the weapon has no DV table in the system.
CCK.Attack.no-defense: Combat Kit: {defender} did not defend; the melee attack was not resolved.
CCK.Gm.no-gm: Combat Kit: a Game Master must be online to change other characters.
CCK.Gm.timeout: Combat Kit: the Game Master did not answer in time; damage was not applied.
CCK.Gm.invalid: Combat Kit: the Game Master rejected invalid values.
CCK.Gm.forbidden: Combat Kit: you cannot act for this character.
CCK.Gm.not-found: Combat Kit: the character no longer exists.
CCK.Gm.failed: Combat Kit: the Game Master could not apply the change (see console).
CCK.Defense.Title: Defense
CCK.Defense.RangedHint: Dodge with DEX + Evasion, or take the DV ({dv}).
CCK.Attack.mode-autofire: Combat Kit: this weapon has no autofire.
CCK.Attack.mode-suppressive: Combat Kit: this weapon cannot lay down suppressive fire.
CCK.Attack.mode-aimed: Combat Kit: you cannot make an aimed shot with shells or explosives.
CCK.Attack.mode-thrown: Combat Kit: only melee weapons can be thrown this way.
CCK.Attack.thrown-only: Combat Kit: this weapon can only be thrown.
CCK.Wound.MortalCritical: Was already Mortally Wounded: also suffers a Critical Injury to the body (roll on the system table).
CCK.Attack.no-martial-arts: Combat Kit: Martial Arts needs at least 1 point in the skill.
CCK.Attack.no-ammo-mode: Combat Kit: this fire mode needs 10 rounds in the magazine.
CCK.Attack.no-skill: Combat Kit: the character has no {skill} skill item.
CCK.Defense.AreaHint: Dodge out of the blast with DEX + Evasion; you must beat the attack roll ({dv}).
CCK.Defense.SuppressionHint: Resist with WILL + Concentration against the attack roll ({dv}); if you fail, you must use your next move to take cover.
CCK.Aimed.double-head: Head: damage past the armor doubled.
CCK.Aimed.drop-item: The target drops an item held in its hands.
CCK.Aimed.broken-leg: The target also suffers the Broken Leg critical injury (apply it from the system's table).
CCK.Explosion.Missed: Missed: the GM chooses where the explosive landed, within 10 m of the aimed point.
CCK.Suppression.Note: Line of sight was checked against scene walls. Anyone already in cover or not on foot is unaffected: the GM disregards them.
CCK.Grapple.already: Combat Kit: one of them is already in a grapple.
CCK.Grapple.not-attacker: Combat Kit: select the token that is holding someone in a grapple.
CCK.Grapple.not-defender: Combat Kit: select the token that is being grappled.
CCK.Grapple.Prone: Thrown to the ground: prone, the grapple ended.
CCK.Area.PlaceExplosion: Choose where to aim the explosive
CCK.Area.Controls: Left click: confirm • Right click or Esc: cancel
CCK.Area.empty: Combat Kit: nobody in sight inside the area.
CCK.Settings.VisualsHint: Shows shots, impacts and explosions on the map. Applies to this browser only.
CCK.Settings.SoundsHint: Plays shot, impact and explosion sounds. Applies to this browser only.
CCK.Settings.VolumeHint: Applied on top of the Foundry interface volume.
CCK.Settings.MotionHint: With reduced motion, effects show still for a moment, without animation.
CCK.Menu.Why-no-attacker: Select one of your tokens to attack
CCK.Menu.Why-many-attackers: Select only one of your tokens
CCK.QuickFire.Tool: Quick fire: with one token selected, left-click another token to attack it
CCK.QuickFire.On: Combat Kit: quick fire on. Select your token and left-click a target to attack it.
CCK.Settings.SkipRollDialogsHint: Attacks and grapples from the combat menu and the Character Panel roll straight away, without the system's modifier dialog. Quick fire always skips it.
CCK.Settings.NpcDefenseHint: How NPCs answer dodges, melee defenses, suppression and grapple contests.
CCK.Settings.MenuModifierHint: Hold this key and right-click one of your tokens (or any token, as GM) to open the combat menu instead of the Token HUD. On other people's tokens the menu opens without a key.
CCK.Settings.TargetMarkerHint: Replaces Foundry's target arrows with a HUD-style reticle in the colour chosen in the Character Panel, showing the distance to your token. Other players' targets show as diamonds in their colour.
CCK.Settings.TargetAnimationHint: Lock-on when you mark, breathing corners and the turn indicator pulse. Off (or with reduced motion), everything stays still.
CCK.Target.Label: TARGET
CCK.Settings.TargetModifierHint: Hold this key and left-click a token to make it your only target, or to unmark it, without selecting it.
CCK.Settings.MenuAlwaysHint: Right-click opens the combat menu on any token you have not selected, even as owner or GM. The Token HUD stays on the selected token.
CCK.Menu.Nothing: Nothing to do on this token
CCK.Packs.Title: Content packs
CCK.Packs.MenuHint: Import folders with sounds, images and effects (cck-pack.json) and choose which are active in this world.
CCK.Packs.Hint: Each pack is a folder in the Foundry data area with a cck-pack.json at its root. The first active pack in the list wins when two define the same effect.
CCK.Packs.Duplicate: Combat Kit: that folder is already listed.
CCK.Packs.Error-not-object: The manifest is not valid JSON ({at}).
CCK.Packs.Error-bad-id: Invalid id (lowercase, digits and hyphen; cannot be default or code).
CCK.Packs.Error-bad-kinds: kinds only accepts cues and quickhacks.
CCK.Packs.Error-bad-folder: Invalid folder: {at}. Use a folder in the Foundry data area.
CCK.Cues.Title: Effects per event
CCK.Cues.MenuHint: Choose which effect plays for each combat event, silence events or replace the sound with a file.
CCK.Cues.Hint: Automatic uses the active pack and, without one, the module effect. A sound chosen here replaces the effect sounds and keeps its visuals.
CCK.Cues.ResetDone: Combat Kit: effects per event restored.
CCK.Settings.QuickhacksHint: Turns on the Quickhack engine (Jack In, Breach, Quickhack, Jack Out, Force Out). Quickhack definitions come only from content packs. Reloads the world.
CCK.Settings.NeuroportNamesHint: Installed cyberware whose name contains one of these terms (comma separated) counts as a Neuroport. Items flagged cyberpunk-combat-kit.net = "neuroport" count too.
CCK.Settings.SelfIceNamesHint: Each installed cyberware whose name contains one of these terms counts as one Self-ICE (one Passwall). Flag cyberpunk-combat-kit.net = "selfIce" counts too.
CCK.Defense.JackInIntro: {attacker} tries to connect to the Neuroport of {defender} ({weapon}).
CCK.Defense.JackInHint: Roll WILL + 1d10 to notice the intrusion.
CCK.Defense.ForceOutIntro: {attacker} tries to force {defender} out of their Neuroport ({weapon}).
CCK.Defense.ForceOutHint: Roll Interface to hold the connection.
CCK.Net.Disabled: Combat Kit: Quickhacks are off in this world.
CCK.Net.FirewallHeld: The Neuroport firewall held (DV6 for Interface 1 and 2). The target did not notice.
CCK.Net.RunnerAlwaysAware: The target is a Netrunner and always knows about the intrusion.
CCK.Net.Silent: This Quickhack does not alert the target.
CCK.Net.ChooseRunner: Combat Kit: more than one Netrunner is connected; choose from the menu.
CCK.Net.Locked: The Netrunner cannot reconnect to this target for 60 minutes.
CCK.Net.OutOfRange: Combat Kit: {runner} left the range of {target} and was disconnected.
CCK.Net.Applied-damage: Direct damage to HP, ignoring armor.
CCK.Net.Applied-ongoing: Ongoing damage at the end of each turn of the target until the effect is removed.
CCK.Net.StatusMissing: The condition from the pack does not exist in this world; the GM applies it by hand.
CCK.Net.InjuryMissing: The injury from the pack is not in the system compendiums; the GM applies it by hand.
CCK.Menu.Why-locked: locked for 60 min after being forced out
CCK.Menu.Why-once-per-turn: already Quickhacked this target this turn
CCK.Panel.Menu: Combat menu for the marked target
CCK.Panel.NoTarget: Mark a target (T key or right-click the token) to see combat actions.
CCK.Panel.NoToken: Combat Kit: the panel character has no token in this scene.
CCK.Api.BadDamage: Combat Kit: invalid damage request (see the console).
CCK.Settings.TurnPanelHighlight: Highlight the panel on your turn
CCK.Settings.TurnPanelHighlightHint: The Character Panel border pulses while the character it shows is taking its turn. Needs Character Panel 0.2.1 or newer.
CCK.Settings.TurnIndicatorHint: Shows a plate under the token whose turn it is, with the movement left and the Action (full, half or empty diamond).
CCK.Settings.ActionEconomyHint: In combat, each character has one Move Action (MOVE in squares) and one Action per round. Attacks, grapples, reloads and standing up spend the Action; Run spends the Action to move MOVE again.
CCK.Turn.Label: TURN
CCK.Turn.Badge: Movement left and Action this round
CCK.Turn.BadgeReset: Movement left and Action this round. Click to restore everything.
CCK.Turn.no-action: {name} already used the Action this round.
CCK.Turn.no-move: {name} has no movement left for {squares} more square(s) this round.
CCK.Turn.prone: {name} is prone: stand up (spends the Action) before moving.
CCK.Turn.run-needs-action: {name} already used the Action and cannot run.
CCK.Turn.RunPrompt: {name} is past their movement. Running spends this round’s Action and gives {move} more squares.
CCK.DeathSave.Hint: Rolls a Death Save for each mortally wounded NPC in this combat
CCK.DeathSave.None: No mortally wounded NPC in this combat
